claims.claim: league/candidates/riot.py fetches match timeline (riot.py:339) but only reads frames[].events for the user's kills, special kills, elite monsters; participantFrames unread; nothing cached
cut_window short-circuits to _window_anchor when metadata.anchor_seconds exists; window = anchor ± pad, union with ranker suggestion, cap 120 from start
No League game-end signal exists in the Outplayed path; only Riot gameEndTimestamp
DigestClip.voice is str but gaming-expert story_beats are dicts; voice is empty for all Zeri clips
Jev answers are not persisted; only _log.debug
Mentor corrections file league_examples.jsonl lives untracked in the runner checkout because the API runs there
9:16_hud is a per-edit aspect gated by hud_aspect_enabled; shorts compiler offers only cropped_hud and blur_fill; shorts.py hardcodes -preset veryfast -crf 20
reserve_call counts calls per feature per process; no dollar ledger

redTeamFindings.title: A new riot_events strategy would never run
redTeamFindings.resolution: R1: fight bounds in candidate metadata; _window_anchor branches on them

redTeamFindings.title: One constant offset cannot handle pauses
redTeamFindings.resolution: R3: piecewise align check; widen pre-pad to 8 s on disagreement

redTeamFindings.title: Wrong match pick cached and reused
redTeamFindings.resolution: R4: confidence gate; cache keyed by asset id with confidence

redTeamFindings.title: $2 cap has no dollar ledger
redTeamFindings.resolution: R5: per-asset SQLite ledger from response.usage

redTeamFindings.title: Correlation refetches 23 calls with no 429 backoff
redTeamFindings.resolution: R6: cache asset→match; honour Retry-After once

redTeamFindings.title: Scorecard depends on an untracked file outside the PR tree
digest_leaks only catches 12+ char verbatim matches
redTeamFindings.resolution: R8: prompt forbids quotes/slurs/names; min_len 8 on voice

redTeamFindings.title: No single owner checks the security hard line across merges
redTeamFindings.resolution: R9: secret-scan before merge and before publish

rulingsNote: Red-team findings were resolved by the Claude session while the owner slept, per D8 (owner: 'you fix all of the code... i care more about moving fast'); each is in the spec's Decisions Log with Source: Red Team and can be overturned.
